prompt.alinti: This GitHub repo is a goldmine for AI developers.
It has 230-plus specialized AI agents for different jobs.
Front-end, back-end, AI, DevOps, security, marketing.
There's an agent for almost everything.
And these aren't just simple prompts.
Each agent has its own role, workflow, and expertise.
You can use them with any AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex with just a single prompt.
Comment agent, and I'll DM you the link.

Birden fazla agent'ın birleştirilmesiyle ürün geliştirme, özellik testleri, pazarlama kampanyaları gibi iş süreçlerinin otomatize edilmesi.
